main_stall_rule: M1 r_ready=cycle%11>=4; source queues exactly one next command while owner holds
reset_offer_rule: R11 offers the future ASSIGN before waiting for held-query target, then holds three further nonreset clocks; all other jobs assert that future offer only at the reset probe. Every job holds it across three reset edges and boot until its one later handshake.
reset_write_rule: R05: MEM_RSP ASSIGN write/RETURN_NODE at node=P+cancel_lo,span1,lazy1. R06: first parent pull write at node=(P+cancel_lo)/2,span2,lazy0. p1 uses singleton index0 in the complete left subtree; other profiles retain their fixed physical-last-leaf singleton.
